key_insight: Uncertainty-based sampling generally improves training-data acquisition, but its effectiveness depends strongly on the model, dataset, and prediction task.
engineering_relevance: Task-aware data acquisition can help allocate limited labelling budgets more efficiently for molecular and materials property prediction.
method: Compare random sampling with multiple active learning strategies.
Evaluate across model classes, representations, datasets, and target properties.
Derive acquisition guidelines for a given labelling budget.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparative evaluation across diverse modelling settings, but provides no numerical performance gains or dataset sizes.
watch_item: Validate acquisition strategies for the intended model and property rather than assuming uncertainty-based sampling will always be best.
paper_title: Systematic Evaluation of Training Data Generation Strategies for Machine Learning-Based Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
